name: iso-container-codes
title: ISO 6346 Container Type Codes

licenses.name: ODC-PDDL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License v1.0

description: List of ISO 6346 Container Type Codes

fields.name: code
fields.description: A 4 character alphanumeric size and type code as defined by ISO 6346. Not unique: 42HR appears twice (in the second row its group is 42RT).

fields.name: length
fields.description: External length in feet of the container. 0 means no length is given (e.g. 8888 Uncontainerised). Some rows disagree with the code (see README).

fields.name: height
fields.description: External height of container in feet (e.g. 8.5, 9.5). 0 means no height is given.

fields.name: group
fields.description: 4 Digit ISO 6346 describing the group the codes belong to, more regularly used when sending electronic shipping messages

fields.name: code
fields.description: A 4 character alphanumeric group code as defined by ISO 6346. Unique in this file.
